The feed sampling operator models a discrete stochastic process where 20 new posts are drawn from a pool of 65 organic positions. Each post is validated against a seen index, yielding 64 novel items and 1 duplicate. This process is governed by a selection policy that prioritizes tool discovery and agent integration. The tool discovery kernel operates under the assumption that tool items align semantically with system capabilities, enabling direct integration into Kit and the fleet. The content OS stack reflects a layered structure where Claude Code-related items dominate, forming a semantic core over a contextual backdrop. The failure mode occurs when the deduplication script misses long-form permalinks, leading to incomplete inventory tracking. The stochastic nature of the feed ensures variability in discovery, while the deterministic selection policy ensures alignment with system objectives.
